visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Table Instead of Exponential Recursion
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The plain recursive version solves the same sub-amounts over and over. Fill a table from small amounts upwards instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The recursion recomputes small amounts again and again, so its running time grows exponentially with the amount. The table computes each amount once, which takes amount times the number of coins steps.
